reviews.t: dr. remedy
reviews.x: i've been using this stuff (in various colors) for a few years, and it has gotten rid of the fungus on two of my four infected toenails. it has also improved the appearance of the two that are still affected. in fact, i just went out with clear polish on my toes (no color) for the first time in about 5 years. my toes were way too gross to even consider doing that before using this! it didn't happen quickly, but it did eventually really improve my disgusting toe fungus!

reviews.t: My Permanent Go-To Brand
reviews.x: I began using this product when an old nail polish gave all ten of my fingers a dark yellow tint/fungus. I was mortified and embarrassed and went online to find products to address. Tried natural remedies, like tea tree oil and OTC meds, and nothing was really working. Mainly I wanted to cover the yellow tint while making sure my now brittle nails were still healing.  Finally came across this product. Was a bit hesitant due to the price, but I needed to try something to get rid of the discolorat

reviews.t: but the base coat is great. I especially love the Hydration Clear Moisturizing Nail ...
reviews.x: I haven't tried the polish or the top coat, but the base coat is great.  I especially love the Hydration Clear Moisturizing Nail Treatment with Biotin.  The treatment goes on like a clear polish and my nails look wonderful, no splitting, breakage, etc.  My manicurist was so impressed she's ordering a bottle and I sent a bottle to a friend of mine who has major nail problems.  Can't wait to hear if it helps her, but my guess is that it will.

reviews.t: Love this polish!!
reviews.x: This is the BEST polish!! I've struggled to get rid of toenail fungus.  After many different treatments and remedies, I tried this and it's unreal how much it helped so quickly.  Word of caution when ordering, I ordered the Rescue Red & the Total Two-In-One Glaze.  I received the Rescue Red & Brave Berry.  I contacted Amazon and they were very nice and put order in for me to receive the correct one and told me to keep the Brave Berry which was very nice.  However, I received the Brave Berry agai

reviews.t: Good Product
reviews.x: This is not as high-gloss as some bottom or top coat, but the lack of harmful ingredients makes it worth it. Looks fine, goes on fine, and I have had both polish and glaze on my toes for over 2 weeks with no wearing or chipping.

reviews.t: Great healthy choice for your nails!
reviews.x: I really like this product. It goes on smooth and dries very fast. It does feel a little thin with just one coat. I would highly recommend two coats if you are wearing it by itself or as a top coat. I use one coat when using it as a base.  It is very “breathable” for those of you trying to get rid of a problem nail and great as a preventative measure to keep healthy nails (fingers or toes). This is my second bottle of this product.

reviews.t: Great clear coat
reviews.x: This clear coat is superior to my former go-to from Essie. It wears well, and leaves a nice finish. I am unsure of the anti-fungal properties, but I think this should be purchased whether that is a concern for you or not.

reviews.t: This glaze is thick, takes forever to dry, ...
reviews.x: This glaze is thick, takes forever to dry, and try as I might, I couldn't get a smooth finish...I tried to return it, but the seller wouldn't take it back, or give me a refund, so buyer, beware!

reviews.t: After 7 days, 95% polish still on nails!
reviews.x: After seven days of wear, the polish still is on my nails about 95%!  I have cooked, typed, cleaned, scratched my dogs, etc. and the vast majority of my polish still is on my nails!  I am very impressed.  The only portion that is somewhat worn is the very tips of my nails, to be expected (albeit sooner than 7 days).  Essie polish tends to start flaking within 24 hours AND it has all of the toxins.  I am sold!

reviews.t: This wonderful Two-in-one clear coat dries super fast!
reviews.x: This is my 'Go To' Base Coat, Top Coat and/or my choice when I just want to go natural. This product helps extend the life of my manicure by 1 - 2 weeks. I add it to my nails every couple of days to prevent chipping.  My absolute favorite quality is how quickly this top/base coat dries completely VERY quickly. I have this nasty be habit of doing my nails right before going to bed and this is the ONLY product that doesn't leave 'Skid Marks' from the sheets. I don't think Dr Remedy advertises how

reviews.t: I can't even begin to describe how much this has ...
reviews.x: I can't even begin to describe how much this has helped clear up my toenails.  It's interesting to watch the lady at the nail salon take off my polish each month and I see that there is no new fungus (or whatever it is) on my nails...just the old stuff growing out.  I bought this along with with one of the Dr.'s Remedy colored polish.  It takes awhile to clear up, but that should be expected.  My nails didn't get ruined overnight, do I didn't expect this to work overnight.

reviews.t: I'm not sure but I think Drs. Remedy products ...
reviews.x: I'm not sure but I think Drs. Remedy products are turning my toenails white and drying them out.  I have eliminated all other possibilities.  I even went without polish for 8 months and when I used this product the white on my nails returned.  Anyone else have this happen?  I don't have fungus and no vitamin deficiency.  It's on all the nails.

reviews.t: Best polish you can buy.
reviews.x: I Love this polish. I've used it for 3 years and it lasts me about 6 months. I paint my nails once a week. It helps keep my nails healthy after battling a fungal infection 3 years ago. I found this polish and haven't had an issue since. It can be used with any other brand of polish in my experience.

reviews.t: ... with the other Dr's Remedy polishes this one is fantastic also. The glaze goes on smooth and helps ...
reviews.x: As with the other Dr's Remedy polishes this one is fantastic also.  The glaze goes on smooth and helps the color polish last longer. I like the fact that it is made without chemicals.

reviews.t: Too thick too soon
reviews.x: I order this all the time, as I am a manicurist and it is a great product for toe nail fungus. Unfortunately my latest bottle turned too thick very soon after opening. I will not be able to use it & it is still over 3/4 full.

reviews.t: Excellent Product Line!
reviews.x: I am so happy that this product is available to help with my damaged toe nail.

reviews.t: An outstanding, long-wearing polish with a clumsy delivery system
reviews.x: I purchased this clear polish to use with a coral color polish of the same brand. I used them as part of a pedicure almost six weeks ago. Both polishes arrived well wrapped and in good condition. The consistency is neither runny nor too thick. The polish has not flaked, chipped, or peeled off. Except for the gap along my cuticles as a result of nail growth, the polish looks as though I applied it today.  I knocked off one star for two reasons. reviews.t: FREE FROM HARMFUL CHEMICALS
reviews.x: I highly recommend this product.  Makes nails shine.  Use as a base or top coat.  Free from harmful chemicals found in regular nail polishes.

reviews.t: Lifts off after a day....
reviews.x: Will not stay on more than 1 day. Can't use as base coat because it lifts off too easy. Plus, my nail condition has not improved at all. I had high hopes based on the reviews, but I would have been satisfied with just a good base coat.  On the bright side, no allergic reactions have occurred, which is why I bought it in the first place.

reviews.t: Great, long lasting product
reviews.x: Great product!  I started using this along with the same brand nail polish and it's the best that I have ever used. I have used this as the base and top coat, along with the same brand color polish and it lasts without chipping for over a week.

reviews.t: Looks like Gel, Works Like Magic!
reviews.x: Wow. I’m a huge skeptic on “natural remedies” and expensive nail polishes like this one. I’ve been using this in combination with “Pale Peach” which is from the same brand. I’ve been battling a nail fungal infection for a long time and my oral meds have been working very slowly. No topical medications have stopped it. I wanted to try this because I just wanted to cover the darn nail! One day I decided to take off the polish to see if there was any improvement and BAM! My nail looked stronger tha

reviews.t: Disappointed
reviews.x: My toenails have been turning white with polish on, and I had hoped that this product (along with a color from this same line) would allow me to enjoy color while avoiding that side effect.  It didn't.  By the next day there was new damage to the nail.  Even if not for that issue, I think the coverage on this particular color would be poor without several coats.  I had high hopes, but was disappointed.  There is also a no-return policy, so choose wisely as you will not be able to return the item

reviews.t: I ended up using a good-quality top coat like Out the Door rather than putting this on top
reviews.x: Dr.'s REMEDY Enriched Two In One Glaze works very well as a base coat.  I would consider using it alone as a gloss coat for fungus prevention on my fingernails.  I ended up using a good-quality top coat like Out the Door rather than putting this on top.  Not sure how that could affect fungus prevention.

reviews.t: My toe looked a lot better after just one application
reviews.x: My toe looked a lot better after just one application.  I really like that I can wear nail polish to cover up the ugly discoloration with this and not worry about transferring fungus to my colored nail polish.

reviews.t: Not tough enough for manicure but great for pedicure.
reviews.x: Great for pedi but not tough enough for mani - discoloration on nails is clearing up after using this brand exclusively for about 8 weeks. Jen C

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product helped clear up or improve toenail fungus and related nail discoloration.
Reviewers frequently praise it as a base/top coat that goes on smooth, dries fast, and extends manicure wear with little chipping.
Several reviewers value that it is made without harmful chemicals and is a healthier choice for nails.
A few reviewers report problems with the formula being too thick, slow to dry, or thickening soon after opening.
One reviewer reports the product turned toenails white and dried them out.
